findings.finding: All 54 literal question/key pairs were independently read and checked, including concrete-scenario player counts, bonus prerequisites, selection domains and card-specific origin/destination wording. No unsupported answer or meaningful missing source-defined target found.
The ledger documents zero additions in both latest passes 17–18. With no addition in this fresh challenge, the narrow supported-target saturation condition is met.

At least seven essential unresolved ruling families remain independently identifiable from the permitted source. Existing conditional/general questions do not answer them. Complete-core gameplay cannot receive PASS.

Early aggregate setup/mobile coverage-map rows still cite older subsets of IDs, but the later dedicated rows correctly map Q52–Q54. This is organizational duplication, not a missing target or key error.

source_limits.trigger: A player has fewer than three own Caballeros in permitted board regions plus court.
source_limits.supported: Each player must return three; King region and Castillo cannot supply them.
source_limits.unresolved: No fallback specifies whether all available pieces return or how an impossible three-piece obligation is resolved. The Decay-of-Authority fallback is card-specific and cannot be silently imported.

source_limits.passage: Send one Caballero from each player from any region
source_limits.trigger: A player has no Caballero in an unprotected board region.
source_limits.supported: Acting player chooses one for every player including self; King region, Castillo and courts are not legal sources.

source_limits.passage: Secret removal of two own Caballeros
source_limits.trigger: An affected fellow player has no eligible occupied region, including holdings only in the King region/Castillo.
source_limits.supported: A two-own region is required when available; singleton occupied region is the stated reduced-quantity case; protected locations cannot supply pieces.
source_limits.unresolved: No legal selection/removal rule for zero eligible occupied regions. Heading affects fellow players, while paragraph says all players select disks; actor participation/removal is not expressly reconciled.

source_limits.passage: Secret return of all own Caballeros from one region
source_limits.trigger: A fellow player has Caballeros only in protected board locations.
source_limits.supported: Chosen region must contain own pieces; no Caballeros in any region is the express exemption; King region/Castillo cannot supply pieces.
source_limits.unresolved: Having pieces solely in the King region does not satisfy the literal no-pieces exemption and provides no legal occupied source. Actor participation also has the same fellow-players/all-players wording tension.

source_limits.passage: Forced Movement versus general Castillo permission
source_limits.trigger: An affected player wants to move forced-Movement pieces into the Castillo.
source_limits.supported: General rules permit Castillo whenever adding/moving Caballeros; specific Movement requires a destination on a secret disk, whose domain omits Castillo.
source_limits.unresolved: The source does not explain precedence or a way to choose Castillo on the disk. Do not assert either a guaranteed Castillo destination or a categorical exclusion as an independently settled ruling.

source_limits.passage: All-4-value special scoring with 4/0/0 mobile scoreboard at Castillo
source_limits.trigger: The mobile 4/0/0 scoreboard is at the Castillo when all 4-value regions are scored.
source_limits.supported: A mobile scoreboard can be placed at Castillo; all-4 passage uses current first value; all-5 explicitly excludes Castillo.
source_limits.unresolved: All-4 text does not expressly decide Castillo membership. Cannot transfer an exclusion from another card or fabricate inclusion.

source_limits.trigger: Fewer than two own Caballeros remain in provinces when The Court special is used.
source_limits.supported: The Court names two own provinces-to-court pieces; power-card recruitment has its own explicit board-supplement option.
source_limits.unresolved: The Court has no stated shortfall/supplement procedure. The general maximum passage concerns movement onto the board and does not unambiguously specify this provinces-to-court special.

source_limits.trigger: Two retained Veto cards are used against each other or against obtaining a Veto.
source_limits.supported: One Veto stops one incomplete special action, is discarded after use, and cannot stop ordinary deployment.
source_limits.unresolved: No explicit stack, priority or cancellation treatment for competing Veto uses. No required new answer is invented.

source_limits.trigger: Multiple players finish furthest along the success track.
source_limits.unresolved: No explicit tie-breaker or explicit shared-win procedure. Q20 correctly states the criterion without inventing either.
